entries.name: write-invariant-frozen-field-unchecked
entries.claim: While a record holds the declared guarded state, an ordinary update cannot change a declared frozen field (first-party stock count and second-app visit).

kills.name: GENERALIZE-1: first-party stock count keeps its exact counting refusals
kills.expected: Expected values to be strictly equal

kills.name: GENERALIZE-1: a second application gets the same writer behaviour purely by declaration
kills.expected: Expected values to be strictly equal

entries.name: write-invariant-not-enforced-on-update
entries.claim: The generic update path enforces the declared invariants against the stored image.

kills.name: GENERALIZE-1: the generic record writer names no stock count and enforces declared invariants on update
kills.expected: the update path enforces the declared invariants
